stale-hit.label: A stale entry one past the count names the giant
stale-hit.explanation: A hill giant stands adjacent to the Warrior while the Teleport Other exclusion list holds one real entry (not the giant) and a stale leftover one past the count — the state a longer earlier evaluation leaves. The original reads that stale entry, matches the giant and rates its danger as zero; the correction reads only the real entries and rates the danger 179.

SETUPSTEP profile
SETUP giant kill=1 power=226
SETUP n=1 idx0=0 idx1=1
SETUP seed=1000 class=Warrior level=1 depth=30 hp=20/20
  stale_tp_other_entry_does_not_exclude_danger  MODE stale-hit
DANGER danger=0
OUTCOME danger=0
